primary_metric: Flickr30k Karpathy validation mean bidirectional R@1

context.probe1_conclusion: C4 has no excess directional asymmetry relative to OpenCLIP; text aggregation is a symmetry and fine-ranking mechanism probe, not a response to an established text-tower bottleneck.

efficiency_gate.latency: full-stack latency Q3 strictly below 9.48 ms

hierarchy.per_encoder: Select T1 if it passes; otherwise select T1-small if it passes; otherwise retain T0. Never train both aggregation variants.
hierarchy.minilm: Reuse existing C4 T0 checkpoints; train the selected aggregation for seeds 42/43/44 only if one passes.
hierarchy.e5: Train E-T0 for seeds 42/43/44 if it passes. Train the selected E aggregation for seeds 42/43/44 only if one passes. If E-T0 passes but neither aggregation passes, E-T0 is diagnostic and cannot be promoted.

promotion.within_encoder: The aggregation replaces T0 only when its three-seed primary-metric gain is greater than sqrt((SD_T0^2 + SD_Tagg^2)/2) and it passed the efficiency gate.
promotion.between_encoders: E5 can displace MiniLM only when its selected eligible candidate exceeds MiniLM's selected eligible candidate by more than sqrt((SD_selected_M^2 + SD_selected_E^2)/2). Otherwise MiniLM wins by continuity.
promotion.directional_metrics: i2t R@1, t2i R@1, MRR and ranking efficiency are diagnostic; directional regressions must be reported but do not silently veto or enable promotion.

hypothesis: Learned text-token selection may improve fine ranking, but captions are short and MiniLM was pretrained with mean pooling, so a smaller gain than vision-token aggregation is expected.
selection_pressure_disclosure: This is an additional Flickr-validation-selected branch; Flickr test remains sealed until the final configuration is frozen.
